videos.script: Two features of the portal accept a whole object from the outside. {{two}} One is a cookie that remembers a patient's text size. The portal reads it back with pickle. {{pickle}} Pickle does not read data. It rebuilds Python objects, whatever objects the bytes describe. Python's own documentation says never to unpickle bytes you do not trust. {{docs}} The other is the exam upload. It keeps the file under the name the browser sent, in a folder the web server serves. {{upload}} A name with two dots in it lands outside the folder. A text file called scan dot pdf is stored as a PDF. {{witness}} The fixes are short. Data in a format that can only hold data. And files under names the portal chooses, checked, limited, and handed back as downloads. {{fixes}}
